title: Domain Generalization for Smartphone-Based Human Activity Recognition: A Systematic Analysis of Components and Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2609.14863v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smartphone-based Human Activity Recognition (HAR) models often degrade under distribution shifts caused by changes in users, devices, sensor placements, environments, and acquisition protocols. Domain Generalization (DG) addresses this problem by learning from source domains without access to target data. Existing DG methods span training objectives, representation initialization, and architectural modifications, but these components are typically evaluated in isolation despite operating at different stages of the learning pipeline. We present a large-scale controlled benchmark of DG for smartphone-based HAR, comprising more than 410,000 experiments across four model architectures, thirteen training objectives including Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM), five initialization strategies, four architectural configurations, and two shift scenarios: cross-dataset and cross-position. translated_title: 基于智能手机的人体活动识别的领域泛化：组件与交互的系统性分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.14863v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：基于智能手机的人体活动识别（HAR）模型在由用户、设备、传感器放置位置、环境和采集协议变化引起的分布偏移下，性能往往会显著下降。领域泛化（DG）通过在不接触目标数据的情况下仅从源域学习来解决这一问题。现有的DG方法涵盖训练目标、表示初始化和架构修改等多个方面，但这些组件通常被孤立地评估，尽管它们实际上作用于学习流程的不同阶段。我们提出了一个针对基于智能手机的HAR领域泛化的大规模受控基准测试，包含超过410,000个实验，涵盖四种模型架构、十三种训练目标（包括经验风险最小化（ERM））、五种初始化策略、四种架构配置，以及两种偏移场景：跨数据集和跨位置。结果表明，单个DG组件所能提供的性能提升有限……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过包含超过41万个实验的大规模受控基准测试，系统评估了训练目标、初始化策略和架构配置等领域泛化组件在智能手机人体活动识别中的单独效果及其交互作用，揭示单个组件的提升有限。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large-scale controlled benchmark of over 410,000 experiments to systematically analyze the individual effects and interactions of domain generalization components—training objectives, initializations, and architectures—for smartphone-based human activity recognition, revealing that single components alone offer limited gains.
